name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Mobile Production Center, AL

fieldNotes.locationCorrection: Roster address (6350 Rangeline Rd) and operator label (Coca-Cola Consolidated) are incorrect. The Mobile production/distribution facility is operated by Coca-Cola UNITED at 5300 Coca-Cola Rd, Mobile AL 36619 (Tillmans Corner). Audited at the corrected location (30.5851, -88.1688 area).
fieldNotes.truckGate: The facility is enclosed by an ornamental metal perimeter fence (seen in Street View); access is via Coca-Cola Rd. A controlled entry is implied by the fenced perimeter but no formal checkpoint structure is clearly visible in satellite imagery — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at the entrance; remoteGs set true on the assumption of a fenced controlled entry without a staffed booth.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large paved yard with trailer parking on the east/north side; ~15 trailers visible at capture, but the site has substantial paved capacity (~50).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Production + distribution hub; dock faces on the building complex estimated ~22 doors. Imagery shows ongoing expansion/construction (the 2021-2022 $48M expansion), so counts are approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Tillmans Corner commercial/industrial area within the Mobile metro.
